igeek-1n9mivp.description:
The Thermal Grizzly CPU Contact Frame Intel 1700 LT is the "Lite" version of the Intel 13th/14th Gen CPU Contact Frame and is manufactured by injection molding. The material used is an acrylonitrile-butadiene-styrene copolymer, which has a 15 percent glass fiber content for additional stability.

 
• Lower CPU temperatures

• Easy mounting

• Glass fiber reinforced ABS plastic

• Compatibility list online

 
 The standard Integrated Loading Mechanism (ILM) has contact points located in the centre of the elongated CPU. Due to the resulting uneven contact pressure of the processor into the socket, the surface of the Integrated Heat Spreader (IHS) curves concavely. As a result, the base plate of the CPU cooler rests primarily on the edges of the IHS, so that the thermal "hotspot" in the middle of the CPU is not optimally covered.

The CPU Contact Frame Intel 1700 LT has a special inner contour to shift the contact pressure from the centre of the CPU to the edges during assembly. This avoids the concave curvature of the IHS. This results in CPU coolers resting better on the processor and a larger contact surface to dissipate the CPU's waste heat.

The installation of the Contact Frame is very simple and takes only a few steps. Depending on the CPU cooler and the CPU used, the temperatures of the processor can be noticeably reduced.

The CPU Contact Frame Intel 1700 LT is compatible with 12th, 13th and 14th generation processors for socket LGA1700. In addition, the frame is only compatible with CPUs whose Integrated Heat Spreader (IHS) has been ground down by no more than 0.2 millimetres. When mounting, make sure that there are no electronic components under the frame. This is especially important for mainboards with the Mini-ITX form factor.

 Removing the mainboard's Integrated Loading Mechanism (ILM) may invalidate the mainboard manufacturer's warranty! 

 Scope of delivery: 

 
• 1x CPU Contact Frame Intel 1700 LT

• 4x pan-head screws UNC thread 3/8"

• 1x hexagon socket wrench 5/64"

• 1x angle wrench Torx T20

Cooler Master i50 Standard Air Cooler – LGA 1700 Compatibility for Intel 12th, 13th & 14th Gen Processors 

 The Cooler Master i50 is a compact, efficient, and cost-effective air cooler designed specifically for Intel’s latest LGA 1700 socket. Supporting Intel’s 12th, 13th, and 14th generation Core processors, this cooler is ideal for budget-conscious users and builders working with space-constrained cases such as mini-ITX and slim desktop towers.

 With a low-profile design and a 92mm fan, the i50 is engineered for quiet operation while delivering sufficient airflow to keep your CPU temperatures under control during everyday computing tasks, office workloads, or light multimedia use.

 
 🔧 Technical Specifications: 

 
• 
 Socket Support: Intel LGA 1700

• 
 Processor Compatibility: Intel Core i3, i5, and i7 (Non-K) – 12th, 13th, 14th Gen

• 
 Fan Size: 92mm diameter

• 
 Fan Speed: Up to 2200 RPM

• 
 Noise Level: Approx. 26 dBA

• 
 Bearing Type: Rifle Bearing

• 
 Airflow: Around 40–41 CFM

• 
 Static Pressure: ~1.9 mm H₂O

• 
 Cooler Height: 60.8mm

• 
 Connector Type: 3-pin (non-PWM)

 
 
 🌟 Key Features: 

 ✅ LGA 1700 Ready 

 This cooler is fully compatible with Intel’s LGA 1700 socket, making it a plug-and-play solution for the latest 12th, 13th, and 14th generation CPUs. Whether you’re using a Core i3-12100 or an i5-13400, the i50 provides adequate cooling without the need for BIOS updates or adapter kits.

 ✅ Low-Profile Design 

 With a height of only 60.8mm, the Cooler Master i50 is ideal for builds where space is limited — such as HTPCs, slim desktops, or mini-ITX enclosures. Despite its compact size, the fan delivers focused airflow across the heatsink’s aluminum fins for effective heat dissipation.

 ✅ 92mm Quiet Fan 

 The pre-installed 92mm fan spins at up to 2200 RPM, delivering airflow of approximately 40 CFM. It uses rifle bearing technology for long-term durability and quiet operation, even at maximum speed. Its low noise level (~26 dBA) ensures your system remains quiet under normal load conditions.

 ✅ Easy Installation 

 The i50 includes a simple mounting mechanism that ensures secure and fast installation, even for first-time PC builders. Its all-in-one design with pre-applied thermal paste also saves time during the assembly process.

 
 ⚠️ Limitations to Consider: 

 While the Cooler Master i50 is a reliable budget option, it’s important to understand its limitations:

 
• 
 Not suitable for unlocked or overclocked CPUs (K-series) such as the i5-13600K or i7-14700K. These CPUs produce more heat than the i50 can effectively handle under load.

• 
 Lack of PWM support: The fan uses a 3-pin connector, which means it runs at a constant speed and doesn’t support dynamic speed adjustments via the motherboard.

• 
 Performance similar to Intel stock coolers: For users expecting a significant thermal performance upgrade, the i50 may not meet expectations. It’s more of a space-optimized replacement rather than a performance-focused upgrade.

 
 
 🎯 Ideal Use Cases: 

 
• 
 Office PCs

• 
 Light home computing

• 
 Budget builds

• 
 Media PCs (HTPCs)

• 
 Systems without high thermal loads

 
 The Cooler Master i50 is not designed for high-performance gaming rigs, content creation systems, or workstations where heat output is high. For those scenarios, mid-range to high-end tower coolers or liquid AIOs are recommended.

igeek-gmrr7t.description:
The Conductonaut liquid metal thermal compound is the further development of Conductonaut and was developed for applications with maximum power density. As a gallium-based liquid metal, Conductonaut Extreme is a metallic alloy that is liquid at room temperature, allowing for the minimum possible layer thickness.

 
• Optimised thermal conductivity compared to conventional liquid metal

• Increased material compatibility

• Optimum application due to metal needle

• Attention: Electrically conductive!

• Do not bring into contact with aluminium!

 
 Conductonaut Extreme thermal paste is technically not a thermal paste, as a paste consists of liquid and solid particles. The disadvantage of a paste is the solid particles. The surfaces of the base plate of the CPU cooler and the CPU heat spreader are uneven on a microscopic level. A traditional thermal paste fills these irregularities unevenly. Since the solid particles are larger than the gaps caused by the unevenness, more distance must be filled between the cooler and the heat spreader.

 A heat-conducting medium in the form of liquid metal does not have this problem because it does not contain any "large" particles. As a result, the surfaces of the CPU cooler and heat spreader are closer together. At the same time, liquid metal has a constant heat transfer, while the larger solid particles in pastes usually conduct heat better than the paste parts. Liquid metal is preferable to thermal paste, especially in high energy applications.

 Conductonaut Extreme is manufactured to the highest quality standards at our production site in Germany. Our expertly trained staff continuously monitor the entire production chain. From testing the purity of the raw material, to the production of the liquid metal and filling, to packaging, production is subject to multiple quality controls.

 Conductonaut Extreme is recommended as a high-end product for experienced users who are looking for a solution with best heat dissipation in the temperature range above 8°C. We recommend applying Conductonaut Extreme on nickel-plated copper as this offers the best long-term stability.

 Scope of delivery 

 
• 1x Syringe with liquid metal

• 1x Metal needle for application

• 1x Plastic needle for absorbing

• 2x Lint-free industrial cotton swabs

• 2x Cleaning pad

 
 Note: Conductonaut Extreme thermal paste must not be used with aluminium coolers!

 Note: Conductonaut Extreme is a metal alloy and may leave optical residues. If the liquid metal diffuses into the heatspreader, the engraved information may become illegible and there is a risk that the manufacturer's warranty will be invalidated.

 For best long-term performance, we recommend heatsinks with nickel-plated copper bases.

Hardcore handheld gamers abound with the spread of Internet and mobile devices as smartphones, tablets, Switch, Steam Deck, etc. Subsequently, heat couldn’t become a more common problem for mobile gamers, especially in some big titles

 To help mobile gamers keep their best advantage, GameSir designed an all-round mobile weapon—F9 Magnetic Cooler—to expel heat in most mobile devices. Besides native magnetic design, it comes with an additional magnetic sheet and a clamp, so that you can use it on any of your mobile devices, be it Android phone, iPhone, tablet, Switch or Steam Deck. Meanwhile, 2 cooling modes with real-time temperature display allow you to control and show how cool you want. If you’re looking for a versatile cooler, F9 is your go-to everywhere you play.

 
 
 
 MagSafe compatible, perfect & native fit for iPhone 12 & 13 series

 Coming with native magnetic design, F9 is a perfect and native fit for MagSafe-compatible iOS devices as iPhone 12 & 13 series. Just put and use.

 With a magnetic sheet, fit other mobile devices without magnetic area

 For other mobile devices without magnetic area, there is an included magnetic sheet. Simply put the magnetic sheet on the mobile device’s back, then you can use F9 by magnetic fixation.

 With a clamp, fit mobile phones with a width of 65-90 mm

 Equipped with a retractable clamp, F9 can also be fixed on most mobile phones as long as they are 65-90 mm in width.

 Fast cooling in 1 second

 Based on Peltier cooling effect, F9 comes with about a 1600 mm²cooling area on the face and heat transfer fins helping fast absorb heat from the Peltier module while the 7-blade fan on the back spinning for superior airflow. With this powerful engineered system, F9 can fast cool in 1 second and even deliver up to a 25°C drop on the phone’s skin temperature. The fan also comes with noise-reduction design and runs at only 25 dB max even under the Hardcore cooling mode.

 
 

 

 
 
 

 

 
 2 cooling modes with real-time temperature display

 Available in 2 cooling modes with real-time temperature display—Normal Cooling Mode & Hardcore Cooling Mode, mobile gamers can control how cool they want by simple pressing the Cooling Mode Switch—Once for Normal Cooling Mode and Twice for Hardcore one.

 360° rotatable, put power input port in any direction

 With 360°rotatable power input port, mobile gamers can customize the included 1.5 m power cable position in their preferred way

 Light on, gamer style on

 Once F9 is plugged-in and enabled the cooling mode, gamer style is lit while the back cooling fan lit with 7-color cycle

 Pocket-sized & lightweight for on-the-go gaming

 F9 is 23.5 mm thick and 59.6 mm in diameter, weighing only 66 g. Pocket-sized and lightweight, it’s a perfect gadget for on-the-go gaming and marathon gaming

 Second use as a phone holder under magnetic fixation

 When F9 is used under magnetic fixation, it can also serve as a phone holder for leisure activities

 The DeepCool AG400 PLUS CPU Cooler is an ultra-efficient single-tower air cooling system engineered specifically to provide superior thermal dissipation for high-performance multi-core Intel and AMD processors. Designed around an advanced push-pull airflow mechanism utilizing dual 120mm PWM fans, the AG400 PLUS delivers a formidable thermal management rating of up to 220W TDP. This robust heat transfer capacity ensures that your system maintains stable operating temperatures and maximum turbo clock speeds even under intensive processing workloads, extended gaming sessions, heavy video rendering, and complex multi-threaded computing applications.

The heatsink structure features an offset architecture that delivers guaranteed 100% RAM clearance without blocking high-profile memory modules or RGB diffusers. Standing at a compact total height of just 150mm, the AG400 PLUS easily fits into standard ATX, Micro-ATX, and compact Mid-Tower chassis, making it one of the most versatile and high-value cooling solutions available for modern high-performance PC builds.

 
 
 
 
 Advanced Push-Pull Airflow Engine with Dual 120mm PWM Fans

 Maximum Air Intake Velocity, Superior Static Pressure, and Accelerated Heat Transfer

 At the heart of the DeepCool AG400 PLUS thermal execution engine is its dual 120mm high-efficiency PWM fan configuration operating in a synchronized push-pull setup. The front intake fan forcefully drives cool external air across the dense aluminum heat sink matrix, while the secondary rear fan rapidly extracts hot air out of the heatsink array and directs it toward the chassis exhaust vents. This dual-fan synergy drastically increases air velocity through the cooling fins compared to standard single-fan tower coolers, ensuring rapid thermal relief for high-heat processor cores.

 Both 120mm fans feature dynamic Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) control ranging from a quiet 500 RPM up to a maximum performance speed of 2000 RPM (±10%). Operating automatically based on real-time motherboard temperature signals, the fans supply up to 75.89 CFM of peak airflow and 2.53 mmAq of static pressure per fan. Built with long-life Hydro Bearing technology, rotational friction and mechanical noise are kept to an absolute minimum, allowing the cooler to maintain whisper-quiet sound profiles during light workloads while delivering full thermal performance under heavy CPU usage.

 
 Direct-Touch Core Touch Technology 2.0 & Bidirectional Heat Pipes

 Four 6mm Copper Heat Pipes with Universal Vertical & Horizontal Gravity Performance

 To achieve ultra-fast heat absorption right from the processor source, the AG400 PLUS employs Core Touch Technology 2.0. Four 6mm high-purity copper heat pipes are precision-machined to form a flat, continuous direct-contact base that sits directly against the processor’s Integrated Heat Spreader (IHS). By eliminating thermal transfer delays typically caused by thick intermediate metal baseplates, heat generated by the CPU cores is instantly conducted straight into the copper heat pipes and distributed across the cooling tower.

 Furthermore, DeepCool integrates its innovative Bidirectional Heat Pipe Balance Technology into the internal structure of the copper pipes. Standard heat pipes can suffer performance drops due to gravitational effects when installed in vertical tower cases. The AG400 PLUS uses an optimized internal capillary wick structure and precise fluid charge ratios to maintain low thermal resistance and maximum capillary action regardless of whether the PC chassis is standing upright vertically or lying down horizontally.

whiteangel-emnmuw.description:
Thermaltake ToughAir 400P CPU Cooler

 The Thermaltake ToughAir 400P is a high-performance single-tower air cooler designed to deliver exceptional thermal dissipation for modern high-count multi-core processors. Built with four direct-touch copper heat pipes and a high-static pressure fan, this cooling solution ensures low operating temperatures under heavy gaming sessions, intensive rendering workloads, and daily desktop multitasking.

 Meticulously engineered for wide system compatibility, the ToughAir 400P features an asymmetric fin structure and optimized heat pipe layout that avoids interference with tall DDR5 and DDR4 memory modules across standard motherboard layouts. Universal mounting brackets provide seamless installation on modern Intel and AMD sockets, making it an ideal choice for durable, high-efficiency PC builds.

 
 
 
 
 Direct-Touch Copper Heat Pipe Architecture

 Maximum Heat Transfer and Rapid Thermal Absorption directly from the CPU IHS

 At the core of the Thermaltake ToughAir 400P are four 6mm high-conductivity copper heat pipes configured with direct-touch technology. By sitting directly against the processor’s integrated heat spreader, these heat pipes rapidly draw thermal energy away from high-density CPU cores into the aluminum fin stack.

 This efficient heat transfer path prevents thermal spikes and ensures clean, consistent cooling performance even during sustained heavy processing tasks.

 
 High Static Pressure TOUGHFAN 12 Cooling Fan

 Optimized Airflow Dynamics and Whisper-Quiet Acoustic Performance

 Equipped with a high-performance 120mm PWM fan, the cooler drives substantial airflow through dense aluminum fin arrays. The fan blades are engineered from liquid crystal polymer materials to minimize vibration and maintain structural rigidity under high operational speeds.

 Equipped with second-generation hydraulic bearings, the fan delivers high static pressure while maintaining ultra-low noise levels for a quiet, distraction-free computing environment.

 
 Asymmetric Fin Design & High RAM Clearance

 Unrestricted Memory Slot Access and Optimized Air Intake Channeling

 The aluminum fin stack utilizes an asymmetric offset design engineered specifically to maximize memory clearance on modern ATX and Micro-ATX motherboards. This layout allows for full access to all DIMM slots, enabling easy installation of tall RGB RAM modules without mechanical interference.

 The precise fin spacing creates optimal air resistance balance, ensuring steady airflow pass-through and rapid heat exhaustion toward the chassis exhaust fans.

 
 Universal Multi-Socket Mounting System

 Hassle-Free Toolless Installation for Current Intel and AMD Desktop Platforms

 Designed for broad system versatility, the ToughAir 400P includes robust, easy-to-install mounting hardware compatible with a wide range of desktop processor sockets. The reinforced metal backplate ensures even mounting pressure across the CPU die for reliable contact surface area.

 Installation is fast and secure, providing peace of mind for both first-time system builders and seasoned hardware enthusiasts.

 
 
 
 Why Choose Thermaltake ToughAir 400P?

 Reliable Air Cooling Performance, Clean Aesthetics, and Outstanding Value

 The Thermaltake ToughAir 400P CPU Cooler offers a powerful balance of efficient heat dissipation, low noise output, and zero RAM interference. With its direct-touch heat pipes and high-static pressure fan design, it keeps modern gaming CPUs running within safe thermal limits without the complexity of liquid cooling loops.

 Whether you are constructing a daily productivity workstation, an esports gaming rig, or upgrading a stock air cooler, the ToughAir 400P delivers long-term hardware reliability, clean aesthetics, and excellent thermal performance.

Thermalright Assassin X 120 R Digital ARGB Black CPU Cooler

 The Thermalright Assassin X 120 R Digital ARGB Black is a sleek, high-performance single-tower air cooler engineered to deliver optimal thermal dissipation for modern desktop processors. Featuring a matte black heatsink coating, four direct-touch copper heat pipes, a vibrant 120mm ARGB PWM fan, and an integrated digital temperature display top cover, this cooler combines reliable cooling performance with real-time system monitoring and stylish visual appeal.

 Designed for broad system compatibility and clean PC builds, the Assassin X 120 R Digital ARGB Black features a streamlined footprint that ensures 100% memory module clearance across standard ATX and Micro-ATX motherboards. With its robust mounting system supporting current Intel and AMD sockets, it provides steady heat dissipation, low acoustic noise, and long-term durability for gaming rigs and daily productivity PCs.

 
 
 
 
 Real-Time Digital Temperature Display Top Cover

 Instant CPU Temperature Monitoring with Stealthy All-Black Aesthetics

 At the top of the Thermalright Assassin X 120 R Digital ARGB Black is an integrated digital display panel. Reading CPU temperatures directly from system sensors in real time, this display provides clear, at-a-glance status updates while keeping your build looking sleek and modern.

 The all-black top cover conceals the heat pipe ends, offering a clean, unified visual profile through side-panel tempered glass cases.

 
 Direct-Touch Copper Heat Pipes & AGHP Technology

 Uncompromised Heat Absorption Regardless of Vertical or Horizontal Mounting

 Equipped with four 6mm nickel-plated copper heat pipes utilizing Anti-Gravity Heat Pipe (AGHP) technology, this cooler maintains high thermal transfer efficiency regardless of installation orientation. The direct-touch base makes contact with the CPU integrated heat spreader (IHS) to pull thermal energy rapidly away from high-density CPU cores.

 Heat is swiftly conducted up into a dense, high-grade aluminum fin array treated with a black anti-oxidation coating for enhanced longevity and heat radiation.

 
 High-Performance S-FDB ARGB PWM Cooling Fan

 Dynamic Speed Control, Low Noise, and Customizable Lighting Effects

 Included with the cooler is a high-static pressure 120mm PWM fan featuring Sturdy Fluid Dynamic Bearings (S-FDB) for smooth, quiet rotation and extended lifespan. The fan dynamically adjusts speeds according to CPU thermal loads, balancing concentrated airflow with quiet operation.

 Integrated 3-pin 5V ARGB LEDs allow for seamless illumination synchronization with main motherboard RGB software ecosystems.

 
 100% RAM Clearance & Universal Socket Compatibility

 Zero Memory Interference Layout and Straightforward Installation

 The single-tower structure is carefully proportioned to sit fully clear of all memory DIMM slots. This design allows users to install tall high-profile RGB memory sticks without encountering mechanical interference.

 Thermalright’s mounting bracket system provides an easy installation experience with balanced contact pressure across current desktop sockets, including Intel LGA 1700 and AMD AM5 platforms.

 
 
 
 Why Choose Thermalright Assassin X 120 R Digital ARGB Black?

 Real-Time Thermal Monitoring, Sleek Stealth Style, and Exceptional Air Cooling

 The Thermalright Assassin X 120 R Digital ARGB Black CPU Cooler offers an impressive blend of thermal efficiency, real-time hardware tracking, and sleek dark aesthetics. With its AGHP heat pipe architecture, ARGB PWM fan, and digital temperature display, it keeps desktop processors running cool while adding a distinct modern touch to your build.

 Whether you are building a budget-friendly gaming desktop, an office workstation, or upgrading a stock air cooler, the Assassin X 120 R Digital ARGB Black provides reliable hardware endurance, low noise output, and outstanding cooling performance.

MSI MAG CORELIQUID A13 240MM Liquid CPU Cooler

 The MSI MAG CORELIQUID A13 240MM is a high-performance liquid CPU cooling solution designed to deliver exceptional thermal efficiency for modern multi-core processors. Featuring a 240mm aluminum radiator, two high-static pressure PWM fans, and a high-durability pump motor, this AIO liquid cooler maintains low operating temperatures during high-frame-rate gaming sessions and heavy computing workloads.

 Engineered for versatile chassis compatibility, the MAG CORELIQUID A13 240MM incorporates customizable ARGB lighting, multi-layer evaporation-proof tubing, and broad support for modern desktop platforms. Its micro-grooved copper cold plate and optimized fluid routing provide reliable heat absorption, high structural endurance, and quiet acoustic operation for compact to mid-tower PC builds.

 
 
 
 
 High-Efficiency 240mm Aluminum Radiator & Copper Cold Plate

 Rapid Thermal Absorption and Dissipation for High-Performance Processors

 At the core of the MSI MAG CORELIQUID A13 240MM is a dense 240mm aluminum radiator paired with a precision-engineered copper contact base. Thermal energy is rapidly pulled away from the CPU integrated heat spreader (IHS) into the liquid loop, where it is transferred across radiator fins for quick heat dissipation.

 This continuous thermal loop prevents heat saturation and ensures reliable CPU performance under multi-threaded rendering and extended gaming sessions.

 
 Dual High-Static Pressure ARGB PWM Cooling Fans

 Dynamic Speed Management and Vibrant System Lighting Customization

 Equipped with two 120mm PWM cooling fans, this liquid cooler delivers high static pressure to force air effectively through the radiator matrix. Pulse-Width Modulation (PWM) speed control dynamically balances airflow and noise output based on real-time CPU thermal loads.

 Integrated 3-pin 5V ARGB LEDs provide rich, customizable lighting effects that sync effortlessly with compatible motherboard software controls.

 
 Reliable Low-Noise Pump & Evaporation-Proof Sleeved Tubing

 Consistent Liquid Circulation with Long-Term Leak Protection

 Engineered for quiet and continuous operation, the integrated liquid pump features a low-vibration motor design that ensures high-flow coolant circulation with minimal noise. Premium bearings minimize mechanical friction for extended operational life.

 The flexible mesh-sleeved tubing utilizes multi-layer evaporation-proof materials to safeguard against fluid loss over time and prevent kinking during installation inside compact desktop cases.

 
 Universal Socket Compatibility & Simplified Mounting

 Broad Support for Current Intel and AMD Desktop Processor Sockets

 Built to fit seamlessly into modern PC builds, the MAG CORELIQUID A13 240MM includes universal mounting hardware supporting Intel LGA 1700 and AMD AM5 sockets, along with legacy desktop platforms.

 The straightforward installation bracket system applies uniform contact pressure across the CPU surface, ensuring optimal thermal transfer and quick assembly for system builders.

 
 
 
 Why Choose MSI MAG CORELIQUID A13 240MM?

 Balanced 240mm Liquid Cooling, Low-Noise Operation, and Vibrant ARGB Style

 The MSI MAG CORELIQUID A13 240MM Liquid CPU Cooler is an excellent choice for PC builders seeking dependable liquid cooling performance in a versatile 240mm format. With its high-static pressure PWM fans, durable pump motor, and customizable ARGB lighting, it provides low thermal resistance and a sleek aesthetic.

 Whether you are building a mid-range gaming desktop, a compact workstation, or upgrading a standard air cooler, this 240mm AIO liquid cooler offers the cooling headroom, durability, and value required for long-term computing performance.

MSI MAG CORELIQUID A13 360MM Liquid CPU Cooler

 The MSI MAG CORELIQUID A13 360MM is a premium liquid CPU cooling system engineered to deliver powerful thermal dissipation for modern high-performance multi-core processors. Featuring a 360mm aluminum radiator, three high-efficiency PWM fans, and a high-durability pump block, this liquid cooler maintains optimal operating temperatures under intense gaming sessions, high-resolution rendering, and heavy desktop workloads.

 Designed with modern PC builders in mind, the MAG CORELIQUID A13 incorporates integrated ARGB lighting, durable evaporated-proof tubing, and wide universal socket support. With its effective heat transfer base and low-noise acoustic profile, it provides the thermal stability, sleek aesthetics, and long-term reliability required for high-end desktop rigs.

 
 
 
 
 High-Efficiency 360mm Aluminum Radiator & Copper Base

 Maximum Heat Dissipation Area for High-TDP Desktop Processors

 At the core of the MSI MAG CORELIQUID A13 360MM is a high-density 360mm aluminum radiator paired with a micro-grooved copper cold plate. Heat is rapidly drawn away from the CPU IHS into the liquid channel, where it is transferred across the radiator’s expanded surface area for swift cooling.

 This optimized liquid-to-air thermal transfer loop keeps modern high-core CPUs running smoothly within safe temperature limits during sustained heavy loads.

 
 High-Static Pressure ARGB PWM Fans

 Dynamic Airflow Control and Customizable System Lighting Aesthetics

 Equipped with three 120mm PWM cooling fans, this liquid cooler drives substantial airflow through dense radiator fins. The PWM control allows fan speeds to adjust dynamically based on system temperatures, delivering silent operation during light tasks and maximum cooling during heavy gaming.

 Integrated ARGB LEDs provide vibrant lighting effects that synchronize seamlessly across compatible motherboards via software interfaces.

 
 Durable High-Flow Pump & Evaporation-Proof Tubing

 Long-Lasting Liquid Circulation and Leak-Resistant Hardware Construction

 Built for long-term operational durability, the integrated pump motor delivers reliable, high-volume coolant circulation with minimal acoustic noise and vibration. High-quality bearings keep the pump operating quietly even at full speed.

 The flexible mesh-sleeved tubing features multi-layer evaporation-proof construction, preventing coolant loss over time and ensuring structural integrity against bending or kinking during system assembly.

 
 Universal Socket Compatibility & Easy Installation

 Seamless Mounting Hardware Support for Modern Intel and AMD Platforms

 Designed to fit effortlessly into mainstream PC builds, the MAG CORELIQUID A13 360MM comes equipped with robust mounting brackets compatible with modern Intel and AMD desktop sockets, including Intel LGA 1700 and AMD AM5.

 The straightforward mounting design ensures balanced pressure across the CPU contact surface, maximizing thermal transfer efficiency for first-time builders and enthusiasts alike.

 
 
 
 Why Choose MSI MAG CORELIQUID A13 360MM?

 Superior Liquid Cooling, Low-Noise Operation, and Striking Gaming Style

 The MSI MAG CORELIQUID A13 360MM Liquid CPU Cooler offers a complete cooling solution for builders looking to keep powerful processors running at peak performance. With its 360mm radiator, high-static pressure PWM fans, durable pump motor, and ARGB customization, it delivers exceptional thermal stability and clean visual appeal.

 Whether you are assembling a competitive gaming setup, building a video editing workstation, or upgrading an existing desktop, this 360mm AIO cooler provides the thermal headroom and hardware endurance needed for demanding computing applications.

Cooler Master MasterLiquid Core LCD 360 Liquid CPU Cooler

 The Cooler Master MasterLiquid Core LCD 360 is a premium All-In-One liquid CPU cooling system engineered for high-performance multi-core processors. Featuring a 360mm aluminum radiator, three high-static pressure PWM fans, and a dual-chamber pump with a customizable LCD screen, this liquid cooler maintains optimal operating temperatures under demanding gaming sessions, video rendering, and heavy multitasking.

 Designed to elevate both thermal control and PC aesthetics, the MasterLiquid Core LCD 360 features real-time hardware monitoring or personalized visuals directly on the pump head screen. Built with durable evaporation-proof sleeved tubing and broad universal socket support, this AIO cooler provides exceptional thermal stability, quiet acoustic performance, and long-term reliability for modern desktop rigs.

 
 
 
 
 Customizable LCD Display Pump & Dual-Chamber Design

 Real-Time System Monitoring and Unique Personal Visual Customization

 At the core of the Cooler Master MasterLiquid Core LCD 360 is an upgraded dual-chamber pump paired with a crisp LCD display. The pump isolates hot coolant from clean intake liquid for efficient thermal transfer, while the LCD screen allows builders to display live system stats, customized graphics, or logos.

 This high-efficiency circulation engine keeps high-TDP desktop processors running steadily within safe thermal limits during intense multi-threaded workloads.

 Universal mounting brackets support current Intel LGA 1700 and AMD AM5 sockets, providing uniform contact pressure across the processor integrated heat spreader (IHS) for straightforward assembly.

Republic of Gamers (ROG), part of the ASUS family, is dedicated to creating innovative hardcore gaming hardware for gamers. ROG is committed to providing the absolute best performance and quality from its complete line of products. ROG is for those keen on the finest gaming hardware and software, it enables the ultimate computing experience for gamers and enthusiasts worldwide. All the while incorporating a stylish gamer-focused design merging the excitement of gaming with a unique premium style

 ROG RYUJIN 360

 ROG Ryujin 360 all-in-one liquid CPU cooler with LiveDash colour OLED, Aura Sync RGB and Noctua iPPC 2000 PWM 120mm radiator fan

 
• 1.77” colour OLED for real-time system stats and personalised logos or animations

• Embedded microfan helps to cool VRM and M.2 area by up to 20°C

• Quality Noctua Industrial PPC PWM fans deliver high airflow and minimal noise

• LiveDash one-stop control centre for lighting and OLED display

• Individually addressable RGB and NCVM coating pump cover accentuates the sleek, modern aesthetics

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 : 
 : 
 : 

 
 
 
 
 Noctua IndustrialPPC fan

 ROG Ryujin meets the thermal challenges of the latest multi-core CPUs with industrial-grade Noctua iPPC-2000 PWM fans on the radiator that deliver high performance and low-noise operation. The 120-mm fans generate 122 CFM of airflow at 2,000 RPM yet are extremely efficient with a 29.7-dB(A) acoustic footprint that’s much quieter than competing fans.: 
 
 Pump embedded fan

 While powerful, liquid cooling does not circulate air around the CPU socket like a traditional heatsink and fan. ROG Ryujin overcomes this limitation with a 60mm fan embedded in the pump housing that circulates air to the CPU VRMs, M.2 slot and surrounding components to dramatically reduce temperatures for improved performance and stability.: 
 
 LiveDash OLED

 ROG Ryujin is AIO cooler to feature an embedded 1.77-inch LiveDash color OLED that displays useful system information*, such as temperatures, voltages, fan speeds, or frequencies. You can also customize LiveDash to display a customized image or animation** highlighting your clan insignia or gamertag.

 *Hardware monitoring feature is only compatible with ASUS motherboards.

 **OLED only support GIF’s and JPG files which are 160 x 128 pixels.: 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 : 
 : 
 : 

 
 
 
 
 Subtle, striking, sleek

 Infused with Aura RGB lighting in dramatic slash patterns on the shroud, Ryujin exudes a vibrant glow that highlights the CPU at the heart of your build: 
 
 PERFECT SYNCHRONIZATION

 The impact of Aura RGB lighting can be further enhanced with ASUS Aura Sync, which allows harmonised lighting effects with other Aura-enabled system components and external accessories. Aura software give you complete control of lighting across all compatible devices, letting you dial in the vibe you want to display quickly and easily.: 
 
 EXTENDED COMPATIBILITY

 ROG Ryujin is compatible with a wide range of Intel and AMD motherboard platforms, giving you the flexibility to pair it with your choice of processor. It also comes fitted with 38cm of tubing to make mounting and routing easier.:
